en-US.title: Frameago
en-US.subtitle: Your before & after journal
en-US.description:
Small moments. Visible progress.

Frameago is a quiet place for the things you grow, make, and become. Take a photo today, add another when things change, and see how far you've come.

START WITH A PHOTO
Take a picture or choose one from your library. Your story starts right away. Titles, notes, dates, and categories are there when you need them, without getting in the way.

SEE WHAT CHANGED
Keep dated moments together in a visual timeline. Choose two photos and drag the comparison slider to see the details side by side.

MAKE A LITTLE MOVIE
Turn your comparison into a six-second vertical MP4 with a moving slider. Preview it, save it to Photos, or share it with an app you choose. You can also export a still image.

YOUR STORY STAYS YOURS
Your journal lives on your device. No account, ads, subscriptions, analytics, or cloud sync. Photos and videos are processed locally, and nothing is posted automatically.

FOR EVERY KIND OF PROGRESS
Plants, creative projects, a room coming together, a collection taking shape: give the changes you care about a place to live.

Frameago is free. An included sample story lets you try the comparison before adding your own photos.

Please keep copies of important photos. Removing the app can remove your journal; exported images and videos are keepsakes, not a complete journal backup.

Questions or ideas? pavelkurmachev@gmail.com
en-US.promoText: Keep a photo today. Come back when things change. Compare your moments and save a six-second video — all on your device.
